description:
Response body for ``POST /products/avails``.

Honest-availability policy: every number is derived from catalog
data — nothing is fabricated. Optional fields with no value are
OMITTED from the wire, not sent as ``null`` (readers tolerate ``null``
from pre-contract emitters).

availableImpressions.description: REQUIRED (policy 1). Products without a capacity cap report the requested volume as available.
availableImpressions.title: Availableimpressions

availableTargeting.description: Targeting dimensions the product supports; omitted when the product declares none.
availableTargeting.title: Availabletargeting

deliveryConfidence.description: Forecast confidence percentage. OPTIONAL — OMITTED entirely when the seller has no forecast data source (policy 2); never fabricated.
deliveryConfidence.title: Deliveryconfidence

estimatedCpm.description: CPM the availability is priced at (base CPM, falling back to floor CPM). OpenDirect 2.1 float dialect (FD-11 exception).
estimatedCpm.title: Estimatedcpm

guaranteedImpressions.description: Present ONLY for PG-capable products (policy 3); omitted otherwise.
guaranteedImpressions.title: Guaranteedimpressions

totalCost.description: availableImpressions / 1000 * estimatedCpm, rounded to 2 decimals. OpenDirect 2.1 float dialect (FD-11 exception).
totalCost.title: Totalcost

title: AvailsResponse
